generate_build_projects: run generate_projects.py with build JSON files to render Mako templates into project build files
preprocess_build_json: run generate_projects.py to preprocess build JSON files using mako_renderer.py and discovered plugins
render_template_files: run generate_projects.py to render .template files into output files using preprocessed build data
generate_projects_with_custom_base: run generate_projects.py with --base flag to output generated project files to a custom directory
test_generated_projects: set TEST env var and run generate_projects.py to diff generated output against expected results
